s: Din tashmish hammitta ubo g' seipim: tashmish hammitta mittaanuge shabbat hu. Lepikak onat talmide chakamim habberiim, shehi paam achat beshabua, qebauha millel shabbat lelel shabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman r"m:

Mittaqqanat ezra leekol shum o shear debarim hammarbim zera beereb shabbat o belel shabbat, bishbil qiyyum haona. Vetzarik lizzaher shello lebattel haona, shello yaabor al lo taaseh shel tora ella im ken haishsha mochelet. Veap al pi ken tob leqayyemah, kemo shennitbaer sham:

Muttar libol betula lekattechilla beshabbat, veen bazeh issur mishshum hatztzaar sheyyesh lah beshabbat bibila rishona. Vegam en issur mishshum chobel bemah shemmotzi dam, lepi sheddam habbetulim eno mubla bekotle bet harechem, ella kanus hu sham kemupqad umutzna betok hakkeli, vezeh eno ella kepoteach hakkeli sheyyetze haddam mittoko. Vegam en issur bemah sheasa petach begup haishsha, lepi shehi melaka sheenah tzerika legupah, sheen tzarik lepetach zeh kelal sheyyehe patuach, lepi shehabbetula nocha lo yoter. Veap lehaomerim shemmelaka sheenah tzerika legupah chayyab aleha, mikkol maqom zeh meqalqel hu, shehabbetula chashuba min habbeula, vekol hamqalqelim peturim. Veap shellekattechilla asur middibre soperim ap im hi melaka sheenah tzerika legupah umeqalqel, mikkol maqom bimqom mitzva lo gazeru chakamim. Veod, sheissur liptoach petach hu mishshum [me]taqqen keli, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shk"ch, ukesheeno tzarik lepetach zeh — en zeh tiqqun kelal, velo asa kelum, kemo sheyyitbaer sham:
